title: TP3. Five-sample nonvanishing certificate
milestone_description: For a real linear functional L on R[X], five distinct nodes y, five strictly positive weights w and moment agreement L(X^m)=sum_j w_j y_j^m for 0<=m<=4, every nonzero polynomial of degree at most four whose five sampled values are weakly of one sign satisfies L(p)!=0. This is the exact composition of local nodes FQ and TP: FQ supplies the cubature identity, the root count excludes a vanishing quartic, and positivity of the weights converts weak sign into strict non-vanishing. It does not assert that the actual weights are positive (that is the Gaussian-moment input GC) nor that any actual moving output passes the test (open target T5).
